## Research, overlap decision and publication

- **Reader question:** Does a local `agentsight report serve` or record web UI provide authenticated network access, and what changes with `--listen`? **New decision:** distinguish loopback reachability, Origin filtering, and actual Direct Node bearer capabilities.
- Primary v1.0.35 sources: [CLI global listen and report serve](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/c1574366122a90c451bca6a84713e28813ab95e2/collector/src/main.rs); [loopback default and server startup](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/c1574366122a90c451bca6a84713e28813ab95e2/collector/src/cmd_trace.rs); [API/Origin/capability gates and tests](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/c1574366122a90c451bca6a84713e28813ab95e2/collector/src/server/web.rs); [bind authentication](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/c1574366122a90c451bca6a84713e28813ab95e2/collector/src/cmd_bind.rs); [capability scopes](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/c1574366122a90c451bca6a84713e28813ab95e2/collector/src/server/capability.rs).
- **Source-level finding:** ordinary WebServer starts with `direct_auth: None`; absent Direct auth, snapshot API permits requests without Origin, while rejecting disallowed Origin-bearing requests. Default listener is 127.0.0.1. Explicit 0.0.0.0 binding changes reachability without enabling bearer authorization. `agentsight bind` separately configures bearer and scoped capability checks. This is an opt-in exposure risk, **not** a demonstrated exploit or a known production incident. The article gives a loopback-only inspection procedure and safe deployment boundaries, without probing foreign targets.
- Overlap check: [Direct Node credentials](/blog/how-agentsight-direct-node-credentials-work/) owns browser pairing, relay and token life cycle; [report source selection](/blog/how-agentsight-report-selects-a-session/) owns evidence provenance; neither answers the plain local server's reachability/API authorization decision. Thus a new canonical URL `/blog/when-agentsight-local-web-ui-is-exposed/` has a distinct reader question and source-backed decision matrix.
- **Scope:** add one TechArticle, one Blog entry and CollectionPage entry, one explicit sitemap URL, this daily and current status. Preserve all existing routes, layout, release claims, analytics, runtime/security code, protected operating controls, and scheduling. Rollback is revert of the resulting squash commit. Public acceptance: exact-commit published HTML has article H1, canonical/TechArticle and sourced matrix; Blog and sitemap contain the new URL; homepage, old report article and GA4 remain unchanged.
- Local `npm run verify` cannot execute because this runtime cannot resolve github.com (confirmed git remote lookup); require ordinary exact-head Website CI (`npm run verify` and scope guard), GitGuardian, Cloudflare and complete post-CI review. No bypass, fabricated build, invented traffic, or private data.
